name: gad_amazon
description: Amazon review-fraud graph with real labelled fraudsters (10,224 nodes, 25 features, 693 anomalies).
notes: Not to be confused with bond_inj_amazon, which is PyGOD's Amazon co-purchase graph with *injected* outliers: 13,752 nodes and 767 features. Different graph, same word. ada_gad and diffgad are deliberately absent from compatible_methods: each refuses to run on a dataset its authors shipped no tuned configuration for, and inventing one would publish a number from hyperparameters nobody chose. Stored as the upstream .mat rather than converted to a PyG .pt at fetch time: the conversion needs torch and torch_geometric, and the manager is a thin orchestration node that carries neither. The .mat methods read this file directly with no conversion at all; a method wanting PyG calls graflag_runner.read_mat inside its own container, where those libraries exist.
